# envgrid

> envgrid is a small, open-source, self-hosted env manager: a web app where a team keeps its environment variables, constants and config files for each environment, such as test, uat and prod. Each file is shown as a grid with keys as rows and environments as columns, so missing and differing values stand out before a release. Every value is encrypted at rest and has a full version history. It is one Go binary and one SQLite file, released under the MIT licence.

envgrid imports and exports .env, JSON, YAML, INI, .properties, PHP constants and CSV, and keeps any other text file whole. It has two roles, admin and member; a protected environment (prod by default) turns a member's edit into a change request that an admin approves. A command line client, `envgrid export` and `envgrid run`, reads values with an API token. envgrid has no integrations and no cloud service: you run it yourself, with Docker (image `ghcr.io/achal13jain/envgrid`) or a single binary for Linux, macOS or Windows. On your own computer, `envgrid init` sets it up once and keeps the master key in the system's secure store (Windows DPAPI, the macOS Keychain or a Linux desktop keyring), so `envgrid serve` needs nothing set afterwards. Every link below is plain Markdown or plain text.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Achal13jain/envgrid/main/README.md): what envgrid is, and the quick start with and without Docker
- [Features](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Achal13jain/envgrid/main/docs/features.md): everything envgrid does, what it does not do, and the roadmap
- [Configuration and operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Achal13jain/envgrid/main/docs/configuration.md): environment variables, the command line client, backup and restore, and building from source
- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Achal13jain/envgrid/main/SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability, who can do what, and the security model
- [API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Achal13jain/envgrid/main/docs/api.md): the JSON API under /api/v1 and its endpoints

## Source and releases

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Achal13jain/envgrid): source code, issues and pull requests
- [Latest release](https://github.com/Achal13jain/envgrid/releases/latest): archives for Linux, macOS and Windows with SHA-256 checksums
- [Docker image](https://github.com/Achal13jain/envgrid/pkgs/container/envgrid): `ghcr.io/achal13jain/envgrid`, for amd64 and arm64
